TermTranslation.definition: A test that looks at body waste to check for problems with the stomach, intestines or other parts of the digestive system.

TermTranslation.term: chimâi â nitûchischâyihtâkiniwich tân â itâspinâyin - anitâh chitiyihch kiyâh mâk chitichishîhch
TermTranslation.term_syllabics: ᒋᒫᐃ ᐋ ᓂᑑᒋᔅᒑᔨᐦᑖᑭᓂᐎᒡ ᑖᓐ ᐋ ᐃᑖᔅᐱᓈᔨᓐ - ᐊᓂᑖᐦ ᒋᑎᔨᐦᒡ ᑭᔮᐦ ᒫᒃ ᒋᑎᒋᔒᐦᒡ
TermTranslation.public_note_en: an examination of the stool to check for illness in the stomach and intestines

TermTranslation.term: chimei e nitûchischeyihtâkanuwihch tân e itâspaneyin - aniteh chitaihch nesht chitachishîhch
TermTranslation.term_syllabics: ᒋᒣᐃ ᐁ ᓂᑑᒋᔅᒉᔨᐦᑖᑲᓄᐎᐦᒡ ᑖᓐ ᐁ ᐃᑖᔅᐸᓀᔨᓐ - ᐊᓂᑌᐦ ᒋᑕᐃᐦᒡ ᓀᔥᑦ ᒋᑕᒋᔒᐦᒡ
TermTranslation.public_note_en: an examination of the stool to check for illness in the stomach and intestines
